description: This file defines a validator class for the Form object in the OpenMRS API, ensuring that form instances meet certain validation criteria such as non-null fields, proper version format, and field length constraints.

classes.name: FormValidator
classes.description: A validator class for the Form object that implements Spring's Validator interface, ensuring the form's data validity according to specified rules.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines whether the given class can be validated by this validator; supports only the Form class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a given Form object, checking for null/empty fields, regex pattern on version, and field length constraints.
